asset.name: CanvasViewport
asset.description: The spatial workspace surface with pan, zoom, fit, bounds, coordinate conversion, selection, overlays, shortcuts, and high-frequency updates kept outside React rendering.

requires.reason: Pointer capture, constraints, and velocity keep movement outside React rendering.
Continuous transform values update without routing frames through React state.

signatureMoment.description: Panning and zooming track the input exactly with no perceptible lag at any content size, so the canvas feels like a surface being moved rather than a view being recomputed.

rationale: The strictest performance contract in the catalog. Pointer and zoom values must never flow through a store or React state at animation frequency, which is the single rule that determines whether a spatial tool feels alive or broken.
